'''Dure''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant Undercity]]. After a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] flown by a group of [[Believers]] crashed in the Undercity, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] that were pursuing it arrived shortly afterwards and Krood was among a group including the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ilok]], the [[Coruscani ogre]] [[Bartle]] and the Trandoshans [[Krood]] and [[Sounac]], who attacked them.
